simple.meaning: נְקָרָה (nᵉqârâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a fissure.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נְקָרָה (H5366) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 33:22, with occurrences in Exodus, Isaiah.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נְקָרָה (H5366) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נְקָרָה (nᵉqârâh) / H5366 is traced through Exodus 33:22, Isaiah 2:21 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
